ZimaBlue: Evolving Generalizable World Action Models through Scalable Video Pre-training VLA

World Action Models egocentric video pre-training Slow-Fast dual-system architecture zero-shot real-robot scalable robotic control

简要说明：ZimaBlue 提出了一个可扩展的世界动作模型（WAM）框架，通过大规模自我中心视频预训练学习通用的机器人操作模型，并利用慢-快双系统架构实现零样本真实机器人成功部署和实时控制。

TLDR: ZimaBlue introduces a scalable framework (WAM) that leverages large-scale egocentric video pre-training to learn generalizable world action models for robotic manipulation, achieving zero-shot real-robot success and real-time control via a Slow-Fast dual-system architecture.

Abstract: Robotic manipulation faces a fundamental scaling challenge: robust generalization demands broad physical experience, yet action-labeled robot trajectories are expensive to collect and inherently limited in diversity. Egocentric videos offer a far more scalable source of embodied experience, capturing object interactions, contact dynamics, tool use, and long-horizon behaviors across diverse environments. The central challenge is how to convert this abundant but action-free experience into effective robot control. We introduce ZimaBlue, a scalable framework for learning generalizable World Action Models (WAMs) from large-scale video. ZimaBlue follows a three-stage training curriculum: it first performs causal embodied video pre-training on large-scale human and robot egocentric videos, then grounds the learned visual dynamics in heterogeneous robot trajectories through video-action mid-training with a unified action representation, and finally specializes the model to a target robot for deployment. To make generative WAMs practical for real-time control, ZimaBluefurther adopts an asynchronous Slow-Fast dual-system architecture, where a high-capacity Slow world model provides generalizable spatiotemporal representations and a lightweight Fast branch enables 30 Hz action prediction on NVIDIA RTX 4090. On real-robot zero-shot evaluations, scaling from target-robot data alone to over 120,000 hours of embodied video improves success from 36.1% to 77.8%. ZimaBlue further delivers strong performance across multiple benchmarks, with particularly pronounced gains on unseen tasks.

摘要（中文）：机器人操作面临一个根本性的规模化挑战：鲁棒泛化需要广泛的物理经验，然而带有动作标注的机器人轨迹数据收集成本高昂且多样性天生受限。第一人称视角视频提供了更具可扩展性的具身经验来源，能够捕捉跨多样环境中的物体交互、接触动力学、工具使用及长周期行为。核心挑战在于如何将这种丰富但缺乏动作标注的经验转化为有效的机器人控制。我们提出ZimaBlue——一个从大规模视频中学习可泛化世界动作模型（WAMs）的可扩展框架。ZimaBlue采用三阶段训练课程：首先在大规模人类与机器人第一人称视频上进行因果具身视频预训练，随后通过统一动作表征的视频-动作中间训练将学习到的视觉动力学锚定到异构机器人轨迹中，最后将模型适配到目标机器人进行部署。为使生成式WAMs适用于实时控制，ZimaBlue进一步采用异步快慢双系统架构：高容量慢速世界模型提供可泛化的时空表征，轻量级快速分支则在NVIDIA RTX 4090上实现30赫兹动作预测。在真实机器人零样本评估中，将训练数据从仅含目标机器人数据扩展至超过12万小时的具身视频，成功率从36.1%提升至77.8%。ZimaBlue在多个基准测试中均展现出强劲性能，尤其在未见任务上取得了显著提升。

Authors: Xionghao Wu, Yijun Yang, Shiyang Zhou, Haoze Sun, Jianhui Liu, Songsong Yu, Jiyao Zhang, Wenbo Li, Bo Wang, Guoqing Ma, Lin Song, Renjie Liao, Shenghe Zheng, Wei Tang, Xiaojuan Qi, Yanwei Li, Yuan Zhang, Zhuotao Tian, Haoyang Huang, Nan Duan

Facet-0: A Robotic Foundation Model for Contact-Rich Precise Manipulation Manipulation

robotic foundation model contact-rich manipulation action-wrench prediction reinforcement learning post-training sub-millimeter assembly

简要说明：Facet-0是一个机器人基础模型，通过流匹配和RL后训练统一视觉语言、运动学状态和力矩历史，实现亚毫米精度的接触式装配任务。

TLDR: Facet-0 is a robotic foundation model that unifies vision-language, kinematic state, and wrench history via flow matching and RL post-training to achieve sub-millimeter precision in contact-rich assembly tasks.

Abstract: Real-world robotic assembly at sub-millimeter tolerances demands spatial precision, compliant interaction, and robustness to contact failures. We present Facet-0, a robotic foundation model that predicts and values the contact consequences of its actions. Facet-0 unifies multimodal representation learning and reinforcement learning (RL) post-training around a joint action-wrench proposal: a causal wrench history is aligned with vision-language semantics and kinematic state, and flow matching generates each action chunk together with the future wrist-wrench profile it is expected to induce. Deployment rollouts train a distributional Action-Wrench Critic to distinguish motions with similar task progress but different contact outcomes, while phase-aware rewards and contact-selective credit concentrate policy improvement on decisive interactions. To accommodate part-specific dynamics, a lightweight bounded actor reuses the frozen representation for on-robot adaptation; RL remains defined over executable Cartesian actions, while an auxiliary wrench head preserves predictive, non-commanded action-contact coupling. Trained on ManuFacet-1K, a 1,000-hour force-synchronized corpus spanning three embodiments and multiple manufacturing cells, the bounded task-adapted system reaches 82% mean success on five sub-millimeter computer-assembly tasks, compared with 15% for the strongest baseline, with 0.5 mm placement accuracy and 50 ms command latency.

摘要（中文）：在亚毫米公差下进行真实世界的机器人装配，需要空间精度、柔顺交互以及对接触故障的鲁棒性。我们提出Facet-0，一个能够预测并评估其动作接触后果的机器人基础模型。Facet-0围绕联合动作-力矩命题，统一了多模态表征学习与强化学习（RL）后训练：因果力矩历史与视觉-语言语义及运动学状态对齐，流匹配生成每个动作片段及其预期诱发的未来腕部力矩轮廓。部署推演训练了一个分布式的动作-力矩评判器，用以区分任务进度相似但接触结果不同的动作，同时相位感知奖励与接触选择性信用分配将策略改进聚焦于决定性交互。为适应零件特定动力学，轻量级有界执行器复用冻结表征进行机上自适应；强化学习仍基于可执行笛卡尔动作定义，而辅助力矩头则保留预测性、非指令性的动作-接触耦合。该系统在ManuFacet-1K（一个涵盖三种实体与多个制造单元、时长1000小时的力同步语料库）上训练后，经有界任务自适应，在五项亚毫米计算机装配任务中达到82%的平均成功率，而最强基线仅为15%，同时实现了0.5毫米的放置精度与50毫秒的命令延迟。

Authors: Haoyuan Deng, Haichao Liu, Wenkai Guo, Yuan Ling, Zaijia Yang, Yuanjiang Xue, Haosheng Sun, Liangzi Wang, Ziwei Wang

A System for Fast, Resilient, and Adaptable Loco-Manipulation Behaviors on Humanoid Robots HumanoidEmbodied

loco-manipulation affordance templates behavior architecture runtime editing humanoid robots

简要说明：一种用于人形机器人的行为编排与运行时系统，结合了可供性模板、树结构逻辑和运行时可编辑感知，实现快速、鲁棒的移动操作行为，在Unitree H1-2和Alex上展示了六种任务变体。

TLDR: A behavior authoring and runtime system for humanoid robots that combines affordance templates, a tree-structured logic, and runtime-editable perception to enable fast, resilient loco-manipulation, demonstrated on Unitree H1-2 and Alex across six task variants.

Abstract: There is tremendous value in humanoid robots taking on physically demanding, hazardous, and repetitive work in spaces built for humans. However, a useful robot for these spaces must coordinate locomotion, whole-body motion, perception, contact, and operator supervision. We present a robot-local, runtime-editable behavior authoring and runtime system that addresses these challenges. We argue that behavior architecture can be a primary enabler of capability, speed, and reliability, and that runtime editability enables fast behavior creation, adaptation, extension, and combination. Our behavior architecture combines object-centric Affordance Templates, a tree structure that provides organization and logic, and runtime-editable perception through a behavior scene and primitive scene actions. Our operator interface remains continuously synchronized to the robot for runtime authoring, monitoring, and repair. Action primitives execute through a whole-body controller that supports concurrent body motions and walking. Demonstrations of our system cover six task variants on Unitree H1-2 and Alex. We execute a push door traversal in 34 seconds and sort six balls by color in 45 seconds under human disturbance. Timed authoring sessions show scratch creation of new loco-manipulation behaviors and adaptation of existing ones in hours. Comparison against the literature finds our approach to be competitive with recent learned systems.

摘要（中文）：人形机器人在为人类设计的空间中承担高体力、危险及重复性工作具有巨大价值。然而，适用于此类空间的机器人必须协调运动、全身动作、感知、接触和操作员监督。我们提出一种基于机器人本地、运行时可编辑的行为编写与运行系统来解决这些挑战。我们认为行为架构能显著提升能力、速度与可靠性，而运行时可编辑性则支持快速行为创建、适配、扩展与组合。 我们的行为架构融合了以对象为中心的“可供性模板”（一种提供组织架构与逻辑的树结构），以及通过行为场景与原始场景动作实现的运行时可编辑感知系统。操作员界面与机器人持续同步，支持运行时编写、监控与修复。动作原语通过支持并发身体运动与行走的全身控制器执行。 系统演示涵盖Unitree H1-2与Alex机器人上的六种任务变体。我们在34秒内完成推门穿越任务，并在人为干扰下于45秒内完成六个球体的按颜色分拣。计时编写测试表明，可在数小时内从零创建新的移动操作行为，或对现有行为进行适配。与文献对比显示，我们的方法在性能上与近期基于学习的系统具有竞争力。

Authors: Duncan Calvert, Luigi Penco, Dexton Anderson, Tomasz Bialek, Arghya Chatterjee, Beomyeong Park, Robert Griffin

Does Imitation Learning Preserve Temporal Robustness in Dexterous Manipulation? An Expert-Learner Comparison Across Task Execution Speeds Manipulation

imitation learning temporal robustness dexterous manipulation Action Chunking with Transformers execution speed

简要说明：本文比较了脚本专家和通过模仿学习的ACT策略在执行灵巧操作任务时的时序鲁棒性，发现相同的标称成功率并不能保证在执行速度变化时保留专家性能，学习者在高速下性能下降更严重。

TLDR: This paper compares the temporal robustness of a scripted expert and an imitation-learned ACT policy for dexterous manipulation, finding that equal nominal success does not guarantee preserved performance across execution speeds, with the learner degrading more severely at faster speeds.

Abstract: Dexterous manipulation policies learned by imitation are typically evaluated for robustness to variation in scenes, objects, or instructions, but their performance across task execution speeds is less often examined. This leaves open how much temporal robustness a learner retains relative to the expert it imitates. We compare an expert and learner under the same task conditions, initial-condition draws, and speedup factors. We instantiate the evaluation in ParcelStow, a contact-rich task in which the robot acquires, reorients, and inserts a parcel. The demonstrations span the speedup range for the manipulation phases after parcel acquisition. A scripted expert and an Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT) policy trained from the expert's demonstrations both achieve 100 percent task success at nominal speed. Their success rates diverge within the demonstrated range: at its maximum, expert success is 84 percent and ACT success is 53 percent. Two ACT policies with different parameter initializations show similar degradation, decreasing by 34 and 48 percentage points from nominal speed to the maximum demonstrated speed, compared with 16 points for the expert. Stage-level analysis shows that 35 of ACT's 47 failures at the maximum demonstrated speed are insertion misalignments. Under the relative-motion handoff, every ACT acquisition retains the parcel through reorientation and transfer in free space, but only 64 percent complete the overall task, compared with 95 percent after expert acquisition. Across all evaluated policies and speeds, none of the 414 acquisitions without force closure completes the task. Equal nominal task success therefore does not imply preservation of expert performance across execution speeds. Code, data, and evaluation scripts are available at https://github.com/coenwerem/parcelstow.

摘要（中文）：通过模仿学习得到的灵巧操作策略，通常针对场景、物体或指令的变化鲁棒性进行评估，但其在不同任务执行速度下的表现则较少被研究。这引出一个问题：学习模型相对于其模仿的专家，究竟保留了多少时间维度的鲁棒性。我们在相同的任务条件、初始条件采样和加速因子下对专家与学习模型进行了比较。我们将评估实例化于ParcelStow这一高接触性任务中，机器人需完成包裹的获取、重新定向与插入操作。演示数据覆盖了包裹获取后各操作阶段的加速范围。一个基于脚本的专家模型与一个基于专家演示训练的Action Chunking with Transformers（ACT）策略，在标称速度下均实现了100%的任务成功率。然而在演示速度范围内，两者的成功率出现分化：在最大演示速度下，专家成功率为84%，而ACT成功率为53%。两种不同参数初始化的ACT策略表现出类似的性能退化，从标称速度到最大演示速度分别下降了34和48个百分点，而专家仅下降16个百分点。阶段级分析表明，在最大演示速度下，ACT的47次失败中有35次源于插入对齐偏差。在相对运动交接模式下，ACT的每次获取都能在自由空间内通过重新定向与转移保持包裹，但仅有64%完成整体任务，而专家获取后这一比例为95%。在所有评估的策略与速度条件下，未实现力闭合的414次获取均未能完成任务。因此，标称成功率相等并不意味着专家在多种执行速度下的性能被保留。代码、数据及评估脚本见https://github.com/coenwerem/parcelstow。

Authors: Clinton Enwerem, John S. Baras, Calin Belta

EmbodiedSkills: A Unified Framework for Orchestrating, Training, and Deploying VLA Agents VLA

Vision-language-action models skill interface closed-loop execution prerequisite verification structured trajectories

简要说明：EmbodiedSkills 提出了一个统一的框架，通过可执行技能接口在 VLA 动作预测周围添加前置条件检查和结果验证，实现了闭环的长时序任务执行和可替换的低层策略。

TLDR: EmbodiedSkills proposes a unified framework with an executable-skill interface that adds prerequisite checks and outcome verification around VLA action predictions, enabling closed-loop long-horizon task execution and replaceable low-level policies.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models map visual observations and language instructions directly to robot actions, but long-horizon tasks require more than action prediction. An agent must coordinate perception, planning, execution, progress verification, and recovery as the physical state evolves. An action prediction or a model-generated skill decision does not, by itself, guarantee that the proposed operation is valid in the current state or that its outcome will be verified. We propose EmbodiedSkills, a unified framework that treats each skill decision as an execution proposal: the runtime checks its prerequisites before execution and verifies the outcome afterward. A shared executable-skill interface connects high-level skill selection, bounded low-level VLA execution, and post-action verification within a single agent loop. Because this interface remains fixed, low-level VLA policies can be replaced or adapted without changing the agent loop. The interface also records planning, execution, verification, and recovery events as structured trajectories, which provide supervision for individual components and can support optional online adaptation when interactive feedback is available. We instantiate EmbodiedSkills with Qwen3-VL and OpenPI/pi0.5 on RoboTwin 2.0 and LIBERO. Task-adapted low-level VLA policies achieve an average success rate of 86.20% across 50 RoboTwin 2.0 tasks and 97.40% across the four LIBERO suites. These results establish the execution performance of the task-adapted low-level VLA policies used in EmbodiedSkills. On four memory-dependent RMBench tasks, the same task-adapted execution approach achieves 12.5% average success. The framework provides a trainable and inspectable agent layer for turning these policies into closed-loop embodied systems.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型将视觉观测和语言指令直接映射为机器人动作，但长期任务所需的远不止动作预测。智能体必须随着物理状态的演变，协调感知、规划、执行、进度验证与恢复。仅凭动作预测或模型生成的技能决策，本身并不能保证所提议的操作在当前状态下有效，也无法确保其结果将被验证。我们提出EmbodiedSkills，一个统一框架，将每个技能决策视为执行提案：运行时在执行前检查其前提条件，并在执行后验证其结果。一个共享的可执行技能接口将高层技能选择、受限的低层VLA执行以及动作后验证连接在单一智能体循环中。由于该接口保持固定，低层VLA策略可在不改变智能体循环的情况下进行替换或适配。该接口还将规划、执行、验证和恢复事件记录为结构化轨迹，为各个组件提供监督，并在交互反馈可用时支持可选的在线适配。我们在RoboTwin 2.0和LIBERO上，结合Qwen3-VL与OpenPI/pi0.5实例化了EmbodiedSkills。经过任务适配的低层VLA策略在50个RoboTwin 2.0任务中平均成功率达到86.20%，在四个LIBERO套件中达到97.40%。这些结果确立了EmbodiedSkills中所使用的任务适配低层VLA策略的执行性能。在四个依赖记忆的RMBench任务中，相同的任务适配执行方法平均成功率为12.5%。该框架提供了一个可训练且可检查的智能体层，用于将这些策略转化为闭环具身系统。

Authors: Wei Wang, Wenqiao Zhang, Yutong Lin, Yuqian Yuan, Tianwei Lin, Jinhao Mao, Zhenxuan Fan, Mingjian Gao, Yang Dai, Wentong Li, Zheqi Lv, Zheng Dong, Yingjie Niu, Jiaqi Zhu, Jun Xiao, Chao Li, Yueting Zhuang

REFACTOR-VLA: Unsupervised Library Learning of Typed Motor Programs VLA

vision-language-action models skill discovery world model behavioral equivalence library learning

简要说明：REFACTOR-VLA 提出了一种基于世界模型和行为等价核的睡眠/觉醒系统，用于发现可复用的类型化运动程序库，从而提升 VLA 模型在长时域任务中的表现和可解释性。

TLDR: REFACTOR-VLA introduces a wake/sleep system that uses a learned world model and behavioral-equivalence kernel to discover reusable, typed motor-program libraries for VLA models, improving long-horizon task performance and interpretability.

Abstract: Most vision-language-action (VLA) models -- OpenVLA, $π_0$, RT-2, RDT-1B -- are monolithic: they emit raw motor commands or short action chunks without organizing behavior into reusable abstractions, so they degrade on long-horizon tasks and resist interpretation. Existing skill-discovery methods sidestep the core question of when two action sequences are behaviorally equivalent, either clustering contrastive embeddings or delegating the judgment to a language model uncalibrated to the robot's dynamics. We introduce REFACTOR-VLA, a wake/sleep system for learning reusable skills. Its sleep phase clusters motor-program fragments under a Behavioral-Equivalence Kernel (BEK) computed from rollouts of a learned latent world model $M_φ$; its wake phase emits typed lambda terms over a Hindley--Milner-inspired vocabulary, consumed by a library-conditioned rectified-flow action decoder. Abstractions are admitted only if they pass Minimum Description Length and return-preservation gates. On LIBERO we report two findings. First, enlarging the world model from 188M to 430M parameters worsened performance on 4 of 4 suites, so capacity alone does not help. Second, the training objective matters far more: adding an auxiliary supervised contrastive (InfoNCE) loss during world-model warmup substantially improves sleep-phase clustering, giving Normalized Mutual Information at $n=3$ seeds of $0.462 \pm 0.021$ (object), $0.867 \pm 0.025$ (spatial), $0.915 \pm 0.013$ (goal) and $0.754 \pm 0.010$ (LIBERO-10), and beating the strongest published baseline on all 4 suites by a mean $Δ= +0.184$. Across providers ($n=12$) the 95% bootstrap confidence interval for mean pairwise NMI is $[0.683, 0.729]$ (mean $0.705$). The sleep phase also yields the first real-LIBERO task-language library: the decoder uses 2 of 3 admitted abstractions and rewrites all 256 sampled demonstrations.

摘要（中文）：大多数视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型——如OpenVLA、π₀、RT-2、RDT-1B——均为单体架构：它们直接输出原始电机指令或短动作片段，未将行为组织为可复用的抽象表示，因此在长时域任务中性能下降且难以解释。现有技能发现方法回避了"两个动作序列何时行为等价"这一核心问题，要么对对比嵌入进行聚类，要么将判断委托给未针对机器人动力学校准的语言模型。我们提出REFACTOR-VLA，一种用于学习可复用技能的"觉醒/睡眠"系统。其睡眠阶段基于从学习到的隐式世界模型M_φ的 rollout 中计算出的行为等价核（BEK）对运动程序片段进行聚类；觉醒阶段则基于受Hindley-Milner启发的词汇表发射类型化lambda项，并由库条件化整流流动作解码器消费。抽象表示仅当通过最小描述长度与保留保真度门限时才被接纳。在LIBERO基准上，我们报告两项发现：首先，将世界模型参数从1.88亿扩大至4.3亿，反而导致四个套件性能均下降，表明单纯增加容量无益；其次，训练目标的影响更为显著——在世界模型预热阶段引入辅助监督对比（InfoNCE）损失，可大幅改善睡眠阶段聚类质量，在n=3个随机种子下获得归一化互信息（NMI）：物体维度0.462±0.021、空间维度0.867±0.025、目标维度0.915±0.013、LIBERO-10维度0.754±0.010，并在全部四个套件上平均领先最强已发表基线Δ=+0.184。跨供应商（n=12）的95%自助法置信区间显示平均成对NMI为[0.683, 0.729]（均值0.705）。睡眠阶段还生成了首个真实LIBERO任务语言库：解码器使用3个被接纳抽象中的2个，并重写了全部256条采样示范。

Authors: Riyaaz Shaik, Chandru Venkataraman

Accelerating Reinforcement Learning via MPC Solver-Gradient Guidance for Weights-varying MPC AutonomousDriving

Model Predictive Control Reinforcement Learning Solver-gradient guidance Autonomous racing Sample efficiency

简要说明：本文提出了 SG-RL 方法，通过将可微 MPC 的求解器梯度引导增强到强化学习中，以提高在线成本权重调整的样本效率，并在自动驾驶赛车上进行了验证。

TLDR: This paper proposes SG-RL, a method that augments reinforcement learning with solver-gradient guidance from differentiable MPC to improve sample efficiency for online cost-weight adaptation, validated on autonomous racing platforms.

Abstract: In Model Predictive Control (MPC), cost-function weights shape closed-loop behavior, yet changing conditions often make fixed parametrizations suboptimal and motivate context-dependent online adaptation. Learning such policies is difficult because behavior depends implicitly on numerical MPC solutions, producing nonlinear, potentially nonsmooth, long-horizon dependencies on policy parameters. This creates a bias-variance tradeoff: Reinforcement Learning (RL) optimizes realized closed-loop return from environment samples but is sample-inefficient, whereas Gradient-Based Policy Learning (GB-PL) uses low-variance solver gradients from differentiable MPC to optimize surrogate losses on predicted trajectories but can be biased under model mismatch. We propose Solver-Gradient Guided Reinforcement Learning (SG-RL), a solver-sensitivity augmentation for RL-based online MPC cost-weight adaptation. SG-RL keeps sampled closed-loop return as the objective and uses bounded solver-derived gradients as auxiliary guidance to improve stability and sample efficiency. We instantiate SG-RL in Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) with four modular algorithms that inject solver-gradient guidance into actor-update scaling, policy loss, advantage estimation, and value-function learning. On two full-scale autonomous racing platforms with intentional model mismatch, SG-RL reaches PPO's best closed-loop return with up to 70.6% fewer samples, outperforms GB-PL baselines by at least 54% in closed-loop return, and generalizes zero-shot to unseen environments.

摘要（中文）：在模型预测控制（MPC）中，代价函数权重决定了闭环行为，然而变化的环境常使固定参数化设置变得次优，并促使人们采用依赖于环境的在线自适应策略。学习此类策略具有挑战性，因为闭环行为隐式依赖于MPC的数值解，导致策略参数产生非线性、可能非光滑且具有长时域依赖性的影响。这引发了偏差-方差权衡问题：强化学习（RL）通过环境样本优化实际闭环收益但样本效率低下，而基于梯度的策略学习（GB-PL）利用可微MPC的低方差求解器梯度优化预测轨迹上的代理损失，但存在模型失配时的偏差风险。我们提出求解器梯度引导强化学习（SG-RL），一种用于基于RL的在线MPC代价权重自适应的求解器灵敏度增强方法。SG-RL以采样的闭环收益为目标函数，并利用有界的求解器导出梯度作为辅助引导，以提升稳定性和样本效率。我们在近端策略优化（PPO）框架中实现了SG-RL的四种模块化算法，将求解器梯度引导注入到演员更新缩放、策略损失、优势估计及价值函数学习中。在存在有意模型失配的两个全尺寸自主赛车平台上，SG-RL达到PPO最优闭环收益所需样本量最多减少70.6%，闭环收益比GB-PL基线至少高出54%，并实现了对未见环境的零次泛化。

Authors: Baha Zarrouki, Arslan Thobani, Jasper Hoffmann, Mattia Piccinini, Rudolf Reiter, Felix Jahncke, Sébastien Gros, Davide Scaramuzza, Johannes Betz

ProxPI: Proximal Prior Injection for Sampling-Based MPC under Learned-Prior Mismatch Manipulation

model predictive path integral control policy-guided warm-start sampling-based MPC learned-prior mismatch real-robot experiment

简要说明：ProxPI 是一种基于采样的 MPC 方法，通过保留名义中心采样并利用软接近代价纳入策略先验，解决了策略先验不匹配的问题，在分布内和分布外任务下均能保持稳健性能。

TLDR: ProxPI is a sampling-based MPC method that addresses policy-prior mismatch by retaining nominal-centered sampling and incorporating the policy via a soft proximity cost, ensuring robust performance under both in-distribution and out-of-distribution tasks.

Abstract: Combining learned policies with model predictive control can leverage learned task priors while retaining online adaptation to new objectives and constraints, but performance degrades when the policy is out of distribution. In policy-guided model predictive path integral (MPPI) control, a policy-centered warm-start approach centers the sampling distribution on the policy output. When the prior is mismatched, centering the sampling distribution on the policy output restricts exploration around an unsuitable solution and prevents recovery toward the task optimum. We propose Proximal Prior Injection (ProxPI), which retains nominal-centered MPPI sampling and incorporates the policy through a soft proximity cost. This matches the in-distribution performance of existing prior-injection schemes while enabling the optimizer to escape an inaccurate policy and recover vanilla MPPI-level performance. We theoretically show that re-centering on the prior discards the optimizer's correction at every update, whereas nominal-centered sampling retains it and converges to a solution set by both the task cost and the prior, and that this failure is not removed by a larger rollout budget. Simulations and real-robot experiments demonstrate robust performance under both in-distribution and out-of-distribution tasks.

摘要（中文）：将学习策略与模型预测控制相结合，能够在保留针对新目标与约束的在线自适应能力的同时利用学习到的任务先验知识，但当策略处于分布外时性能会下降。在策略引导的模型预测路径积分（MPPI）控制中，以策略为中心的热启动方法将采样分布集中于策略输出。当先验不匹配时，将采样分布集中于策略输出会限制围绕不适定解的探索，并阻碍向任务最优解的恢复。我们提出近端先验注入（ProxPI）方法，该方法保留以标称轨迹为中心的MPPI采样，并通过软性邻近代价函数融入策略。该方案在分布内任务中达到现有先验注入方案相当的性能，同时使优化器能够摆脱不准确策略的束缚，恢复至原始MPPI级别的性能。我们从理论上证明：在先验上重新居中会丢弃每次更新的优化器修正，而以标称轨迹为中心的采样则保留该修正并收敛至由任务代价和先验共同确定的解集，且更大的探索预算无法消除该失效模式。仿真与真实机器人实验表明，该方法在分布内与分布外任务中均展现出稳健性能。

Authors: Euncheol Im, Myotaeg Lim, Yisoo Lee

Knowing When to Stop: Adaptive Action Chunking via Internal Cross-Attention Dynamics in VLAs VLA

adaptive action chunking cross-attention dynamics Vision-Language-Action (VLA) entropy-based truncation robotic manipulation

简要说明：本文提出了一种针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的自适应动作分块方法，通过利用内部交叉注意力动态的熵来在线决定执行时长，无需额外训练，在仿真和真实操作任务中提升了成功率。

TLDR: This paper proposes a training-free, adaptive action chunking method for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models that uses the entropy of internal cross-attention dynamics to dynamically determine the execution horizon, improving task success rates across simulation and real-world manipulation benchmarks.

Abstract: Action chunking is a standard execution strategy in modern Vision-Language-Action (VLA) frameworks, but fixed execution horizons impose a trade-off between efficiency and accuracy. Short chunks require frequent inference and may cause oscillatory behavior, whereas long chunks can become misaligned with newly observed states. We address this limitation with an adaptive action chunking approach based on internal cross-attention dynamics in the action expert. We observe that, as the prediction horizon extends, action-to-observation cross-attention becomes increasingly dispersed and its entropy rises toward a plateau. This pattern is associated with higher action prediction error and provides an online signal that the current observation offers limited grounding for further open-loop execution. Based on this observation, we introduce a training-free truncation mechanism that detects sustained high-entropy plateaus and dynamically selects the execution horizon during inference. The method uses attention weights already computed by the policy and introduces negligible additional overhead. Evaluations on $π_{0.5}$ and X-VLA across RoboTwin 2.0, LIBERO, and three real-world manipulation tasks show improved average task success over fixed-horizon and adaptive chunking baselines, while preserving efficient closed-loop control. These results show that cross-attention dynamics can provide a practical internal signal for adaptive action execution in VLAs.

摘要（中文）：动作分块是现代视觉-语言-动作（VLA）框架中的标准执行策略，但固定的执行步长在效率与精度之间引入了权衡。短分块需要频繁推理，可能引发振荡行为；而长分块则可能与新观测到的状态产生偏差。针对这一局限，我们提出一种基于动作专家内部交叉注意力动态的自适应动作分块方法。研究发现，随着预测步长的增加，动作到观测的交叉注意力逐渐分散，其熵值趋于稳定平台。该模式与更高的动作预测误差相关，并提供了在线信号，表明当前观测对进一步的开放式执行所提供的支撑有限。基于此发现，我们引入了一种无需训练的截断机制，该机制能够检测持续的高熵平台，并在推理过程中动态选择执行步长。该方法仅利用策略已计算的注意力权重，引入的计算开销可忽略不计。在RoboTwin 2.0、LIBERO及三项真实世界操作任务上对π₀.₅和X-VLA进行的评估表明，与固定步长及自适应分块基线相比，该方法在保持高效闭环控制的同时提升了平均任务成功率。这些结果表明，交叉注意力动态可为VLA中的自适应动作执行提供实用的内部信号。

Authors: Runze Xu, Xiaolong Shan, Shuang Dai, Yu Wang, Jincheng Yu

Peg-in-Bench: A Modular Benchmark for High-Precision Robotic Insertion Manipulation

peg-in-hole high-precision insertion task generalization modular benchmark scenario generation

简要说明：本文提出一个可重构的模块化插销入孔基准，用于评估高精度机器人插入任务，包含3D打印部件和场景生成工具以支持系统化的泛化性研究。

TLDR: This paper presents a reconfigurable, modular peg-in-hole benchmark for evaluating high-precision robotic insertion tasks, with 3D-printable parts and a scenario generation tool to support systematic generalization studies.

Abstract: High-precision insertion remains a fundamental challenge in robotic manipulation due to the strict alignment requirements and contact-rich interactions involved. Although peg-in-hole tasks are widely used for evaluation, existing bench- marks often rely on fixed task configurations, limiting their ability to assess robustness and generalization across different insertion scenarios. This paper introduces a reconfigurable peg-in-hole benchmark designed to evaluate task generalization in high-precision insertion. The benchmark consists of a set of fully 3D-printable modular components, including multiple peg geometries, tolerance levels, and configurable base structures that can be combined to generate a large variety of insertion and assembly tasks. By varying object layouts, orientations, and task structures while maintaining controlled physical conditions, the benchmark enables systematic evaluation of adaptation to unseen scenarios. To support reproducibility, we additionally provide a scenario generation tool capable of producing standardized task configurations and machine-readable task descriptions. The scenario generation tool and the STL files of the benchmark pieces are available through the project repository: https://github.com/aistairc/peg-in-bench.

摘要（中文）：高精度插入操作因严格的对准要求与丰富的接触交互，仍是机器人操控中的基础性挑战。尽管插销入孔任务被广泛用于性能评估，但现有基准测试通常依赖于固定的任务配置，难以评估不同插入场景下的鲁棒性与泛化能力。本文提出一种可重构的插销入孔基准测试，旨在评估高精度插入中的任务泛化能力。该基准测试包含一系列完全可3D打印的模块化组件，包括多种插销几何形状、公差等级及可配置基座结构，通过组合这些组件可生成大量插入与装配任务。通过改变物体布局、朝向及任务结构，同时保持受控的物理条件，该基准测试能够系统性地评估对未见场景的适应能力。为支持可复现性，我们额外提供一种场景生成工具，可生成标准化任务配置与机器可读的任务描述。该场景生成工具及基准测试部件的STL文件可通过项目仓库获取：https://github.com/aistairc/peg-in-bench。

Authors: Yosel Delgado, José G. Buenaventura-Carreón, Floris Erich, Roman Mykhailyshyn, Tomohiro Motoda, Koshi Makihara, Yukiyasu Domae

Non-Prehensile Throwing: A Reinforcement Learning Perspective RLRobot

non-prehensile throwing reinforcement learning sim-to-real transfer minimum-jerk system identification uncertainty-aware policies

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于强化学习的非抓取式机器人投掷方法，通过学习滑动和滚动接触的关节空间轨迹，在UR5e上实现了仿真和现实世界的高成功率。

TLDR: This paper presents a reinforcement learning approach for non-prehensile robotic throwing that learns joint-space trajectories through sliding and rolling contact, achieving high success rates in both simulation and real-world deployment on a UR5e.

Abstract: Robotic throwing enables fast object transport and extends a robot's reachable workspace beyond traditional pick-and-place. While prehensile (grasp-based) throwing works well for graspable items, non-prehensile (grasp-free) throwing is better suited for large, heavy, and/or deformable objects. Existing approaches rely on model-based optimization with simplified contact models (e.g., dynamic grasping) and low-dimensional trajectory parameterizations, which limit solution quality and reachable workspace. We propose a reinforcement learning approach that additionally leverages sliding and rolling contact modes and directly optimizes joint-space trajectories without analytical contact models or custom parameterizations. The Markov Decision Process (MDP) is formulated as a dynamical system that evolves the robot's joint state conditioned on the throwing target, object model, and initial configuration. Joint-jerk trajectories are planned offline at a low control rate and upsampled into smooth, high-rate velocity commands for deployment. For sim-to-real transfer, we minimize the robot-dynamics gap through minimum-jerk system identification and train uncertainty-aware policies to mitigate object-modeling errors, particularly sensitivity to dynamic friction. In simulation, the policy achieves 99% success across thousands of configurations and generalizes to unseen objects. Sensitivity analysis shows robustness to mass uncertainty but high sensitivity to dynamic friction, consistent with the sliding-based release mechanism. Deployed zero-shot on a UR5e operating near its physical limits (5 m/s end-effector velocity), our method throws diverse objects including heavy (790 g) and large (20x20x28 cm) items to targets up to 350 cm distance or 180 cm elevation, achieving a 97% real-world success rate.

摘要（中文）：机器人抛掷能够实现快速物体运输，并将机器人的可达工作空间扩展到传统拾放操作之外。虽然基于抓取的预hensile抛掷对可抓取物体效果良好，但非prehensile（无抓取）抛掷更适合处理大体积、重型及/或易变形物体。现有方法依赖基于模型的优化，采用简化接触模型（如动态抓取）和低维轨迹参数化，这限制了解决方案质量与可达工作空间。我们提出一种强化学习方法，额外利用滑动与滚动接触模式，无需分析接触模型或自定义参数化即可直接优化关节空间轨迹。该马尔可夫决策过程被构建为一个动态系统，根据抛掷目标、物体模型和初始配置来演化机器人的关节状态。关节加加速度轨迹以低控制速率离线规划，并通过上采样转换为平滑的高速速度指令用于部署。为实现仿真到现实的迁移，我们通过最小加加速度系统辨识缩小机器人动力学差距，并训练不确定性感知策略以减轻物体建模误差，特别是对动态摩擦的敏感性。在仿真中，该策略在数千种配置下达到99%的成功率，且能泛化至未见物体。灵敏度分析表明该方法对质量不确定性具有鲁棒性，但对动态摩擦高度敏感，这与基于滑动的释放机制一致。在接近物理极限（末端执行器速度5米/秒）运行的UR5e机械臂上零样本部署时，我们的方法能将包括重型（790克）和大尺寸（20×20×28厘米）物体在内的多种物品抛掷至最远350厘米距离或最高180厘米高度的目标，真实世界成功率达97%。

Authors: Abdullah Mustafa, Ryo Hanai, Ixchel G. Ramirez-Alpizar, Floris Erich, Ryoichi Nakajo, Yukiyasu Domae, Tetsuya Ogata

ADAPT: Agile Diffusion Action Priors for Robust and Steerable Online Text-Driven Humanoid Control HumanoidEmbodied

diffusion-based action prior text-conditioned humanoid control residual reinforcement learning whole-body control end-to-end closed-loop control

简要说明：ADAPT 提出了一种端到端的框架，用于交互式、文本条件的人形全身控制，该框架从文本标记的轨迹中学习基于扩散的动作先验，并通过残差强化学习策略增强鲁棒性和可控性。

TLDR: ADAPT presents an end-to-end framework for interactive, text-conditioned humanoid whole-body control that learns a diffusion-based action prior from text-labeled trajectories, enhanced by a residual RL policy for robustness and steerability.

Abstract: We present ADAPT, an end-to-end framework for interactive, text-conditioned humanoid whole-body control. Unlike dominant text-to-motion pipelines that generate kinematic motions for a separate tracker, ADAPT solves language control with an end-to-end closed-loop control framework, where the robot must continuously respond to changing commands while maintaining balance, natural motion, and smooth transitions. ADAPT learns a diffusion-based action prior from text-labeled humanoid state-action trajectories, enabling diverse motion skills to be directly executed from language commands. To improve long-horizon robustness and smooth prompt switching, we train a lightweight residual reinforcement learning policy on top of the frozen diffusion controller. We further show that the same diffusion policy can be reused as a steerable text-conditioned motion prior for downstream task adaptation. Experiments demonstrate robust language-grounded skill execution, smooth interactive transitions, and style-preserving downstream control.

摘要（中文）：我们提出ADAPT，一种面向交互式、文本驱动类人全身控制的端到端框架。与主流文本到运动流程（为独立追踪器生成运动学动作）不同，ADAPT采用端到端闭环控制框架解决语言控制问题，使机器人能够在保持平衡、自然动作和平滑过渡的同时，持续响应变化的指令。ADAPT从带有文本标签的类人状态-动作轨迹中学习基于扩散的动作先验，从而支持通过语言指令直接执行多样化运动技能。为提升长时程鲁棒性并实现流畅的指令切换，我们在冻结的扩散控制器之上训练轻量级残差强化学习策略。进一步证明，同一扩散策略可作为可操控的文本条件运动先验，用于下游任务自适应。实验验证了其稳健的语言驱动技能执行、流畅的交互式切换以及保持风格的下游控制能力。

Authors: Yan Wu, Chenhao Li, Kaifeng Zhao, Gen Li, Marco Hutter, Siyu Tang

Behavior--Realization Separation for Constrained Physical Human--Robot Interaction Manipulation

physical human-robot interaction behavior-realization separation receding-horizon quadratic program impedance and admittance control torque-constrained control

简要说明：该论文提出了一种行为-实现分离框架，用于受约束的人机物理交互，将期望行为指定与约束实现视为独立层，并在模拟Franka FR3机器人上展示了其优势。

TLDR: This paper introduces a behavior-realization separation framework for constrained physical human-robot interaction, treating desired-behavior specification and constrained realization as independent layers, and demonstrates its benefits on a simulated Franka FR3 robot.

Abstract: Physical human--robot interaction software often couples desired-behavior specification with constrained realization; we treat these as separate layers. A \emph{behavior layer} supplies a desired contact-port acceleration $a_k^{\mathrm{id}}=f_θ(e_k,\dot e_k,F_{h,k})$. A \emph{realization layer} converts it into constrained robot commands and reports total desired-versus-realized acceleration error instead of hiding it in saturation. A same-objective unconstrained counterfactual separates regularization from constraint intervention, while plant data expose model error. This paper implements a receding-horizon quadratic program realizing memoryless affine behaviors. Changing the behavior modifies objective coefficients through $(C_θ,G_θ)$ while the robot-command variable and feasible set remain unchanged. A planar study instantiates impedance and admittance; the same running layer accepts an impedance--admittance--impedance reassignment without reconstruction, under its existing rate limit. On a torque-controlled 7-DOF Franka FR3 in MuJoCo, the runtime freezes task-space dynamics per solve and enforces torque feasibility across its horizon. Under a sustained 20~N push, it holds a slack-relaxed workspace boundary to within approximately 0.1--0.2~mm, versus 4.4~cm (impedance) and 4.7~cm (admittance) overshoot from instantaneous clipping. A derated actuator budget then activates the torque constraint: horizon-wide enforcement keeps its frozen-model plan feasible to $2.1\times10^{-4}$~N$\cdot$m, whereas a first-step-only ablation plans up to 11.329~N$\cdot$m beyond budget; on the executed nonlinear plant, where both share the same local-model error, the gap is smaller but still favors horizon-wide enforcement (0.161 vs.\ 0.380~N$\cdot$m). These results are a focused proof of behavior--realization separation.

摘要（中文）：物理人机交互软件常将期望行为规范与受限实现耦合在一起；我们将二者作为独立层次处理。**行为层**提供期望的接触端口加速度 $a_k^{\mathrm{id}}=f_θ(e_k,\dot e_k,F_{h,k})$。**实现层**将其转换为受约束的机器人指令，并报告期望与实际加速度的总误差，而非将其隐藏于饱和机制中。一个基于相同目标的无约束反事实设计将正则化与约束干预相分离，同时被控对象数据可揭示模型误差。本文实现了一种采用滚动时域二次规划的方案，用于执行无记忆仿射行为。通过 $(C_θ,G_θ)$ 调整行为可修改目标函数系数，而机器人指令变量与可行域保持不变。一项平面研究实例化了阻抗与导纳模式；同一运行层可在现有速率限制下，无需重构即可接受从阻抗到导纳再到阻抗的重新分配。在 MuJoCo 中基于力矩控制的七自由度 Franka FR3 机器人上，该运行时系统逐次求解冻结任务空间动力学，并在其预测时域内确保力矩可行性。当受到持续 20 N 推力时，该方法将松弛后的工作空间边界误差控制在约 0.1–0.2 mm 范围内，而瞬时截断的阻抗与导纳模式分别产生 4.4 cm 与 4.7 cm 的超调量。在降额执行器预算条件下激活力矩约束后：全时域约束保持使冻结模型计划的可行性误差达 $2.1\times10^{-4}$~N$\cdot$m，而仅首步施加约束的消融实验则产生高达 11.329~N$\cdot$m 的超预算力矩；在实际非线性被控对象上（两者具有相同的局部模型误差），差距虽有所缩小，但仍有利于全时域约束策略（0.161 vs. 0.380~N$\cdot$m）。这些结果集中证明了行为-实现分离架构的有效性。

Authors: Yongyan Cao

DSG: Dynamic 3D Scene Graph Construction for Embodied Agents in Changing Indoor Environments VLN

dynamic scene graph 3D Gaussian scene representation object change detection spatial relationship reasoning AI2-THOR

简要说明：DSG 提出了一个动态3D场景图框架，通过双视角渲染物体变化检测和基于大语言模型的空间关系推理，帮助具身智能体在变化的室内环境中更新场景图。

TLDR: DSG introduces a dynamic 3D scene graph framework that detects object changes and infers spatial relationships in changing indoor environments, leveraging a dual-view rendering method and an LLM-based reasoning module for embodied agents.

Abstract: In indoor environments, object positions frequently change due to human activities or embodied-agent interactions, causing previously constructed scene graphs to become inconsistent with the current scene. To address this issue, we propose DSG, a dynamic 3D scene graph construction framework that detects object changes and performs spatial relationship reasoning. First, we construct a semantic-aware 3D Gaussian scene representation and develop a dual-view rendering-based object change detection method to enable reliable scene graph node updates. Second, we propose a spatial relationship reasoning method that incorporates multi-granularity visual context, enabling a large language model to identify a richer set of interobject spatial relationships. Furthermore, we introduce DynTHOR, a dynamic indoor scene graph benchmark built on the AI2-THOR simulation platform for evaluating scene graph construction in dynamic environments. Extensive experiments on Dyn-THOR, 3RScan, and real-world scenes demonstrate that DSG consistently outperforms existing methods in both object node construction and spatial relationship reasoning, significantly improving the accuracy of dynamic scene graph construction.

摘要（中文）：在室内环境中，物体位置常因人类活动或具身智能体交互而频繁变化，导致预先构建的场景图与当前场景不一致。针对这一问题，我们提出DSG——一种能够检测物体变化并进行空间关系推理的动态三维场景图构建框架。首先，我们构建语义感知的三维高斯场景表示，并开发基于双视角渲染的物体变化检测方法，以实现可靠的场景图节点更新。其次，我们提出融合多粒度视觉上下文的空间关系推理方法，使大语言模型能够识别更丰富的物体间空间关系。此外，我们基于AI2-THOR仿真平台构建了动态室内场景图基准DynTHOR，用于评估动态环境中的场景图构建性能。在Dyn-THOR、3RScan及真实场景上的大量实验表明，DSG在物体节点构建与空间关系推理方面均持续优于现有方法，显著提升了动态场景图构建的准确性。

Authors: Ming Liao, Chao Ye, Jianing Fei, Weiyang Lin

CoLT-Drive: Counterfactual Long-Tail Benchmarking and Knowledge-Preserving Adaptation for Driving Affordance Prediction AutonomousDriving

driving affordance prediction counterfactual benchmark long-tail knowledge-preserving adaptation VLM

简要说明：本文提出了CoLT-Drive，一个用于驾驶行为预测的反事实长尾基准，以及KPA，一种保留知识的自适应框架，可提升小型VLM在该任务上的性能。

TLDR: This paper introduces CoLT-Drive, a counterfactual long-tail benchmark for driving affordance prediction, and KPA, a knowledge-preserving adaptation framework that improves small VLMs for this task.

Abstract: Long-tail autonomous driving failures are often framed as rare-object recognition errors. We argue that this view is incomplete: the decision-critical question is not only whether a model recognizes an unusual object, but whether it infers how that object changes the ego vehicle's feasible high-level actions. We formalize this problem as decision-level driving affordance prediction, where a model maps a front-view image, ego-motion history, and navigation command to a structured longitudinal--lateral meta-action. To evaluate this capability, we introduce CoLT-Drive, a 3,536-sample counterfactual long-tail benchmark that inserts rare objects into otherwise fixed driving scenes and measures whether models predict acceptable action pairs. To improve deployable small VLMs, we propose KPA, a knowledge-preserving adaptation framework that combines structured perception-to-decision prompting, SLERP-based expert merging, and RegMoE, a regime-aware LoRA mixture-of-experts module. KPA preserves the pretrained model's open-world knowledge while allocating lightweight adaptation capacity to different driving decision regimes. Experiments on an in-domain driving split and CoLT-Drive show that KPA achieves 60.8\% pair accuracy on CoLT-Drive, outperforming the pretrained Qwen3-VL-2B baseline (50.3\%) and LoRA SFT (32.4\%) while maintaining competitive in-domain accuracy. Our benchmark and code are available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/tangzx2024/CoLT-Drive and https://github.com/tangzhengxu/CoLT-Drive.

摘要（中文）：长尾自动驾驶故障通常被归因于罕见物体识别错误。我们认为这一观点并不完整：决策关键问题不仅在于模型能否识别异常物体，更在于它能否推断该物体如何改变自车可行的宏观行为。我们将这一问题形式化为决策级驾驶可供性预测任务，模型需将前置摄像头图像、自车运动历史及导航指令映射为结构化的纵向-横向元动作。为评估该能力，我们提出了CoLT-Drive——一个包含3536个样本的反事实长尾基准数据集，通过将罕见物体插入固定驾驶场景，检验模型是否预测出可接受的行动组合。为优化可部署的小型视觉语言模型，我们提出KPA——一种知识保持适配框架，其结合了结构化感知-决策提示、基于SLERP的专家融合，以及RegMoE——一种基于驾驶工况感知的LoRA混合专家模块。KPA在保持预训练模型开放世界知识的同时，为不同驾驶决策工况分配轻量化适配能力。在领域内驾驶测试集和CoLT-Drive上的实验表明，KPA在CoLT-Drive上达到60.8%的行动组合准确率，优于预训练Qwen3-VL-2B基线（50.3%）和LoRA SFT（32.4%），同时保持了相当的领域内精度。我们的基准数据集与代码已发布于https://huggingface.co/datasets/tangzx2024/CoLT-Drive 和 https://github.com/tangzhengxu/CoLT-Drive。

Authors: Zhengxu Tang, Guofeng Cui, Ziyu Gong, Xiaozhou Zhang, Ruifeng Deng, Chengzhi Qi, Ke Chen, Sachin Patil, Tianjun Xiao, Langechuan Liu, Pichao Wang

IMPACT: Attention Is the Interaction Map for Scalable Interaction-Aware World Model Training WorldModel

world model interaction-aware prior-guided calibration diffusion transformer action-conditioned prediction

简要说明：IMPACT 提出了一种交互感知的世界模型训练框架，通过交叉注意力图和局部预测误差重新加权去噪监督，无需外部标注即可提升交互保真度和物理合理性。

TLDR: IMPACT introduces an interaction-aware training framework for world models that reweights denoising supervision using cross-attention maps and local prediction errors, improving interaction fidelity and physical plausibility without external annotations.

Abstract: World models have made remarkable progress in action-conditioned future prediction for embodied agents, yet still struggle to model physically plausible interactions. Existing approaches address this limitation by constraining the generation process with external representations encoding motion, geometry, or semantics. Obtaining these spatiotemporally dense representations typically requires auxiliary estimators or manual annotations, limiting training scalability. We instead revisit the training objective and identify a supervision-allocation mismatch under the globally averaged mean squared error (MSE) denoising objective: prevalent static content dominates the optimization signal, leaving sparse dynamic-object regions critical to interaction generation disproportionately under-supervised. Motivated by this observation, we introduce IMPACT, a scalable Interaction-aware Model training framework with Prior-guided Attention Calibration and Targeting. IMPACT uses cross-attention associated with manipulated-object tokens as an internal spatiotemporal prior for action-conditioned changes. It samples candidate regions from this prior, calibrates them with detached local prediction errors to construct an interaction map, and uses the map to reweight denoising supervision, requiring neither external representations nor inference-time modifications. Extensive experiments on robot-arm and human-hand manipulation, spanning diverse control modalities and DiT backbones, show that IMPACT consistently outperforms the corresponding MSE-trained baselines, improving interaction fidelity, physical plausibility, and visual quality.

摘要（中文）：世界模型在具身智能体的动作条件未来预测方面取得了显著进展，但仍难以对物理上合理的交互进行建模。现有方法通过利用编码运动、几何或语义的外部表示来约束生成过程，从而解决这一局限。获得这些时空密集表示通常需要辅助估计器或人工标注，限制了训练的可扩展性。我们转而重新审视训练目标，并发现全局平均均方误差去噪目标下存在监督分配不匹配问题：占据主导的静态内容主导了优化信号，导致对交互生成至关重要的稀疏动态物体区域被不成比例地欠监督。基于这一观察，我们提出IMPACT，一种具有先验引导注意力校准与目标定位的可扩展交互感知模型训练框架。IMPACT利用与被操控物体令牌相关的交叉注意力作为动作条件变化的内部时空先验。它从该先验中采样候选区域，通过分离的局部预测误差对其进行校准以构建交互图，并利用该图重新加权去噪监督，既不需要外部表示，也不需要推理阶段修改。在跨越多控制模态和DiT主干架构的机器人臂与人类手部操控实验上，IMPACT一致优于对应MSE训练的基线，在交互保真度、物理合理性和视觉质量方面均有所提升。

Authors: Rongze Tang, Jianjie Fang, Zhaolu Wang, Ziyou Wang, Xvyuan Liu, Haisheng Su, Xin Zhang, Wei Wu, Chen Gao, Yong Li, Zhibo Chen

H3-World: Turning Language Understanding into World Control WorldModel

world model video generator language control temporal attention routing zero-shot control

简要说明：H3-World 将预训练的大规模视频生成器转化为交互式世界模型，通过自然语言指令实现精确的角色和相机控制，且仅需轻量级适配。

TLDR: H3-World turns a pretrained large video generator into an interactive world model by using natural-language instructions for precise character and camera control, requiring only lightweight adaptation.

Abstract: We present H3-World, an efficient framework that turns the 33B MiniMax-H3 video generator into an interactive world model. Our key finding is that, as large video generators become more capable, language is emerging as a natural interface for control. MiniMax-H3, for example, already supports zero-shot control of character behavior and camera motion through natural-language instructions. Building on this, H3-World turns this coarse language interface into precise, temporally grounded world control, without introducing dedicated action modules. Specifically, we represent each action as a structured combination of character and camera instructions, and align them with the corresponding temporal video latents. To make the control temporally precise, we further introduce temporal attention routing, which restricts each instruction to its intended time interval and reduces control leakage across actions. Importantly, H3-World directly reuses the semantic representations learned during large-scale video pretraining and requires only lightweight adaptation. With only 8,000 gameplay samples, 10,000 LoRA optimization steps, and 0.199% trainable parameters, H3-World achieves effective character and camera control while preserving strong generation quality. It also generalizes to unseen scenarios. These results show that the control capabilities emerging in large video generators can be efficiently transformed into interactive world control.

摘要（中文）：**摘要：** 我们提出 H3-World，一个将 33B MiniMax-H3 视频生成器转化为交互式世界模型的高效框架。我们的核心发现是：随着大型视频生成器能力的增强，语言正成为一种自然的控制接口。以 MiniMax-H3 为例，它已能通过自然语言指令实现零样本的角色行为控制和镜头运动控制。在此基础上，H3-World 将这种粗略的语言接口转化为精确的、具有时间锚定的世界控制，而无需引入专用的动作模块。具体而言，我们将每个动作表示为角色指令与镜头指令的结构化组合，并将其与对应的时间视频潜变量对齐。为了使控制具有时间精确性，我们进一步引入时间注意力路由机制，该机制将每条指令限制在预期的时间区间内，并减少跨动作的控制泄漏。值得注意的是，H3-World 直接复用了大规模视频预训练过程中习得的语义表征，仅需轻量级适应。仅使用 8000 个游戏样本、10000 步 LoRA 优化以及 0.199% 的可训练参数，H3-World 便能在保持强大生成质量的同时，实现有效的角色与镜头控制，并泛化至未见场景。这些结果表明，大型视频生成器中涌现的控制能力可被高效地转化为交互式世界控制。

Authors: Danze Chen, Zeqing Wang, Ziyue Lin, Xingyi Yang, Yeying Jin

Streaming4D: Accelerate 4D World Models via Block-wise Video Generation and Incremental Reconstruction WorldModel

block-wise video generation incremental 3D reconstruction 4D world models self-forcing autoregressive generator online world representation

简要说明：Streaming4D 提出了一种同步流水线，将逐块视频生成与增量式3D重建相结合，以降低4D世界模型的延迟，在保持几何保真度的同时实现实时交互性能。

TLDR: Streaming4D proposes a synchronous pipeline that integrates block-wise video generation with incremental 3D reconstruction to reduce latency in 4D world models, achieving real-time interactive performance while maintaining geometric fidelity.

Abstract: Current 4D generation paradigms are often bottlenecked by a sequential decoupling design: video is generated first, followed by 3D reconstruction, leading to high interaction latency. This limits applications in interactive real-time scenarios. To this end, we propose \textbf{Streaming4D}, a tightly coupled synchronous pipeline that integrates block-wise autoregressive video generation with incremental 3D reconstruction. Unlike traditional frame-by-frame emission and delayed geometry recovery, Streaming4D generates temporal video blocks and immediately triggers reconstruction for each completed block, enabling parallel execution between synthesis and geometric updates. This approach allows the world representation to evolve online with the video stream, reducing feedback latency while preserving geometric fidelity. We instantiate \textbf{Streaming4D} using a Self-Forcing-style autoregressive generator and an incremental reconstruction backend. Experiments show consistent runtime improvements across resolutions on a single RTX 4090 (1.24$\times$ speedup), while maintaining high-quality 4D geometry and multi-view consistency.

摘要（中文）：当前的4D生成范式通常受限于顺序解耦设计：先生成视频，再进行3D重建，导致交互延迟较高。这限制了其在交互式实时场景中的应用。为此，我们提出\textbf{Streaming4D}——一种紧密耦合的同步流水线，将分块自回归视频生成与增量式3D重建相结合。不同于传统的逐帧输出与延迟几何恢复，Streaming4D生成时间视频块后立即触发每个已完成块的重建，使合成与几何更新能够并行执行。该方法允许世界表示随视频流在线演化，在降低反馈延迟的同时保持几何保真度。我们采用自强制风格的自回归生成器与增量式重建后端实例化\textbf{Streaming4D}。实验表明，在单块RTX 4090上，该方法在不同分辨率下均实现了持续的运行效率提升（加速比1.24倍），同时保持了高质量的4D几何与多视角一致性。

Authors: Xiaoyan Liu, Jiaxin Liu, Kangrui Li, Sifan Zhou

Evaluating Multimodal LLMs as Generalist Vision-Language-Action Agents for Drone Control: Commanding, Approaching, Tracking and Searching VLA

Vision-Language-Action Agent Drone Control Multimodal LLM Benchmark Action Protocol

简要说明：本文提出了DroneCATS基准和DroneCATS-Agent架构，用于评估多模态大语言模型作为通用视觉-语言-行动智能体控制无人机的能力，揭示了空间感知尚可但行动协议纪律（如宣布到达、坐标复制）失败，尤其是小模型，且前沿模型与边缘模型的差距不在于导航而在于持续遵守协议。

TLDR: This paper introduces DroneCATS, a benchmark and DroneCATS-Agent architecture for evaluating Multimodal LLMs as generalist vision-language-action agents controlling drones, revealing that spatial perception holds up but action protocol discipline (declaring arrival, copying coordinates) fails, especially in small models, and that the gap between frontier and edge models is not navigation but sustained protocol adherence.

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are strong perceivers of images and video. We ask how far that reach extends into acting: dropping an MLLM directly into a drone's control loop, with its entire action space declared solely in the prompt. Recent systems approach this setting but increasingly narrow the model's decision-making. We widen it back. We introduce DroneCATS-Agent, an architecture where the MLLM is a swappable component, and DroneCATS, a benchmark treating the model as the independent variable. Beyond merely flying toward a pixel, our agent entrusts the model to yaw and search, deliberate when unsure, and self-declare arrival---all without fine-tuning or function-calling schemas. Evaluating frontier and open models across four core capabilities---approaching a visible target, tracking a moving one, searching outside the initial view, and commanding a multi-drone fleet---reveals that even the simplest embodied settings are far from solved. Crucially, to identify what breaks first at the edge, our roster scales down to 2B parameters. The findings expose a stark paradox: it is not the flying that fails. Small open models often navigate into the success radius more reliably than frontier models, yet lose the episode by declaring arrival prematurely or not at all. Multi-drone commanding amplifies this divide, with small models failing by blindly copying a single coordinate across distinct views. Viewed as vision-language-action agents, the models' spatial perception holds up, but their action protocol does not. What separates a deployable edge model from a frontier model is not navigation, but the discipline to sustain a declared protocol and emit the correct terminating action. The open problem is closing this gap at onboard compute costs---yielding a fast model that plans persistently and knows exactly when it is done---and DroneCATS is built to measure that distance.

摘要（中文）：多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）具备强大的图像与视频感知能力。我们探究这种能力向行动延伸的边界：直接将MLLM植入无人机控制回路，使其全部动作空间仅通过提示词声明。近期已有系统涉足此类场景，但日益压缩模型的决策空间。我们则反其道而行之，拓宽这一空间。我们提出DroneCATS-Agent架构，其中MLLM作为可替换组件，并构建DroneCATS基准测试，将模型视为独立变量。相较于仅向像素点飞行，我们的智能体赋予模型偏航搜索、不确定时审慎推理以及自主宣告抵达的能力——全程无需微调或函数调用模式。通过对四项核心能力（逼近可见目标、追踪移动目标、搜索初始视场外目标、指挥多无人机编队）评估前沿与开源模型发现，即使最简单的具身任务场景也远未得到解决。关键的是，为识别边缘侧首先失效的环节，我们将参数量下限压缩至20亿。研究结果揭示出尖锐悖论：失败根源并非飞行能力。小型开源模型往往能比前沿模型更可靠地飞入成功半径，却因过早宣告抵达或根本不宣告而终止任务回合。多机指挥场景加剧了这一分野：小型模型会盲目将单一坐标复制到不同视角中导致失败。从视觉-语言-动作智能体视角审视，模型的空间感知能力表现稳健，但其动作协议存在缺陷。可部署的边缘模型与前沿模型的本质差异不在于导航能力，而在于遵循声明协议并准确发出终止动作的纪律性。待解决的核心问题在于：如何在机载计算成本约束下弥合这一鸿沟——构建既能持久规划又能精准判定任务完成的快速模型——而DroneCATS正是为度量这个距离而生。

DNC-IMM: Early Lane-Change Intention Recognition via Neural Calibration Based on Driving Context Information AutonomousDriving

lane-change intention interacting multiple model neural calibration driving context early prediction

简要说明：提出了一种双神经校准交互多模型（DNC-IMM），利用驾驶上下文信息提高自动驾驶中早期换道意图识别的准确性。

TLDR: Proposes a Dual Neural-Calibrated Interacting Multiple Model (DNC-IMM) that uses driving context to improve early lane-change intention recognition in autonomous driving.

Abstract: Early recognition of lane-change intention is essential for proactive decision-making in autonomous driving and advanced driver assistance systems. This paper proposes a Dual Neural-Calibrated Interacting Multiple Model (DNC-IMM) that improves adaptability to driving context while preserving the probabilistic structure and interpretability of a conventional IMM. The proposed method encodes driving-context information, including target-vehicle motion, gaps to surrounding vehicles, and relative velocities, with a neural network that calibrates both the transition-probability matrix and measurement likelihoods. The final intention is determined from the calibrated IMM mode posterior rather than from a separate direct classifier. Experiments on the highD dataset demonstrate that the proposed method reliably recognizes lane-change intentions before lane crossing and provides particularly strong performance at the earlier 2-3 s prediction horizons.

摘要（中文）：早期识别换道意图对于自动驾驶和高级驾驶辅助系统中的前瞻性决策至关重要。本文提出了一种双神经校准交互式多模型（DNC-IMM），该方法在保留传统IMM概率结构与可解释性的同时，增强了对驾驶环境的适应性。该方法通过神经网络对目标车辆运动、与周围车辆的间隙以及相对速度等驾驶环境信息进行编码，从而校准转移概率矩阵和测量似然函数。最终意图由校准后的IMM模式后验概率确定，而非通过独立的直接分类器判定。基于highD数据集的实验表明，所提方法能在车道穿越前可靠识别换道意图，并在2-3秒前的早期预测区间内表现出尤为突出的性能。

Authors: Woong-Chan Byun, Seung-Hyun Kong

HitMem: Hierarchical Temporal 3D Memory with Multi-Modal Context-Aware Retrieval for Dynamic Environments VLN

hierarchical temporal 3D memory multi-modal context-aware retrieval object relocation dynamic environments embodied agent

简要说明：HitMem 提出了一种带有层次化时间三维记忆和多模态上下文感知检索的框架，使具身代理能够在动态环境中高效追踪和重新定位被移动的物体。

TLDR: HitMem proposes a hierarchical temporal 3D memory with multi-modal context-aware retrieval that allows embodied agents to efficiently track and relocate displaced objects in dynamic environments.

Abstract: Executing long-term tasks in dynamic environments requires embodied agents to maintain robust and adaptive 3D scene representations. However, most existing 3D memory frameworks rely on static world assumptions. When objects are displaced by human activities or unobserved events, agents encounter memory-observation conflicts and often require costly geometric recomputations or inefficient global re-exploration. To address this, we propose HitMem, a hierarchical temporal 3D memory framework with a multi-modal context-aware retrieval mechanism. Through continuous perception, HitMem unifies semantic and spatial information into a lightweight topological graph that captures support relationships, while a temporal decay mechanism dynamically regulates memory activeness to mitigate the impact of stale representations. In addition, the multi-modal context-aware retrieval mechanism defaults to filtering candidates using integrated semantic, spatial, and temporal memory features, and activates a specialized two-stage retrieval process when object displacement is detected. This process combines spatial constraints inferred from external agent trajectories with semantic common sense grounded in class affinities, efficiently identifying high-probability candidate regions. Extensive evaluations on our constructed Dyna-THOR benchmark demonstrate that HitMem significantly improves object relocation accuracy, reduces exploration costs, and enhances task execution performance in dynamic environments.

摘要（中文）：在动态环境中执行长期任务需要具身智能体维护稳健且自适应的三维场景表示。然而，现有的大多数三维记忆框架均基于静态世界假设。当物体因人类活动或未观测事件发生位移时，智能体会遭遇记忆-观测冲突，通常需要代价高昂的几何重计算或低效的全局重探索。为解决这一问题，我们提出HitMem——一种具备多模态上下文感知检索机制的分层时序三维记忆框架。通过持续感知，HitMem将语义与空间信息统一为轻量级拓扑图以捕获支撑关系，同时时序衰减机制动态调节记忆活跃度，缓解过时表征带来的影响。此外，多模态上下文感知检索机制默认利用集成的语义、空间与时间记忆特征过滤候选对象，并在检测到物体位移时激活专门的两阶段检索流程。该流程结合从外部智能体轨迹推断的空间约束与基于类别亲和性的语义常识，高效识别高概率候选区域。在我们构建的Dyna-THOR基准上的大量评估表明，HitMem显著提升了动态环境中的物体重定位准确率、降低了探索成本并增强了任务执行性能。

Authors: Ruijie Tang, Chenye Zou, Guoquan Wu, Jun Wei, Wei Chen, Jiaxin Zhu

VerNav: Verifier-First Low-Latency Vision-and-Language Navigation VLN

verifier-first low-latency vision-and-language navigation action verification entropy-based adaptive generation

简要说明：VerNav 提出了一种验证器优先的视觉与语言导航框架，用批量动作验证替代每步自回归 LLM 生成，在保持竞争力导航性能的同时将决策阶段延迟降低 10 倍以上。

TLDR: VerNav introduces a verifier-first framework for VLN that replaces per-step autoregressive LLM generation with batched action verification, achieving a 10x reduction in decision-stage latency while maintaining competitive navigation performance.

Abstract: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) requires an agent to navigate through unseen 3D environments according to natural-language instructions. Explicit reasoning can improve instruction understanding and semantic grounding, but autoregressive generation at every step accumulates large decision-stage latency over multi-step navigation. We propose VerNav, a verifier-first framework for low-latency LLM-based VLN. The verifier reduces decision-stage latency by replacing per-step autoregressive generation with batched action verification, while an entropy-based adaptive generator is invoked only for uncertain decisions to produce compact state evidence. To further improve navigation performance with the verifier, we introduce a two-stage alignment scheme: (i) VPO improves local action-preference alignment in static verifier training, and (ii) step-level reinforcement fine-tuning provides dense progress rewards over multi-step navigation rollouts during dynamic task execution. Experiments on the Room-to-Room (R2R) benchmark show that the verifier-only decision path of VerNav achieves competitive navigation performance among representative LLM-based VLN agents while reducing average decision-stage LLM latency per step by more than $10\times$ compared with autoregressive methods.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言导航（VLN）要求智能体根据自然语言指令在未知的三维环境中导航。显式推理能够提升指令理解与语义关联能力，但每一步的自回归生成会在多步导航中累积大量决策阶段延迟。我们提出VerNav——一种面向低延迟大语言模型（LLM）的VLN的验证器优先框架。该验证器通过将每步自回归生成替换为批量化动作验证来降低决策阶段延迟，同时仅在不确定的决策时调用基于熵的适应性生成器，以产生紧凑的状态证据。为利用验证器进一步提升导航性能，我们引入两阶段对齐方案：（i）VPO（验证器偏好优化）在静态验证器训练中改进局部动作偏好对齐，（ii）步骤级强化微调在动态任务执行期间，通过多步导航展开提供密集的进度奖励。在Room-to-Room（R2R）基准上的实验表明，VerNav的纯验证器决策路径在代表性LLM基VLN智能体中取得了具有竞争力的导航性能，同时将每步平均决策阶段LLM延迟降低至自回归方法的十分之一以下。

Authors: Zhixin Wang, Chengzheyi Yao, Leyuan Liu, Xiaosong Zhang, Yongzhao Zhang

A Compact Robotic Finger with 2-DoF MCP Joint Embedding DoF-Selective Passive Continuously Variable Transmission for Wide Force-Speed Operating Range Manipulation

passive continuously variable transmission 2-DoF MCP joint force-speed operating range robotic finger dexterous manipulation

简要说明：本文提出一种紧凑型二自由度机器人手指，采用无源连续可变传动（CVT），根据负载自适应传动比，在无需额外执行器或传感器条件下实现宽力速工作范围。

TLDR: This paper presents a compact 2-DoF robotic finger with a passive continuously variable transmission (CVT) that adapts its transmission ratio based on applied load, achieving a wide force-speed range without extra actuators or sensors.

Abstract: This letter presents a compact two-degree-of-freedom (DoF) robotic finger with a flexion-selective passive continuously variable transmission (CVT) to achieve a wide force-speed operating range. Inspired by the functional differentiation of the human metacarpophalangeal (MCP) joint, the proposed mechanism realizes DoF-specific transmission differentiation by selectively assigning passive CVT to the flexion-extension DoF while preserving direct transmission for abduction-adduction. For a wide force-speed operating range, a force-responsive passive CVT is embedded in the flexion pathway, while direct transmission is preserved for the abduction-adduction pathway. To selectively realize transmission adaptation within a multi-DoF MCP mechanism, an output-side passive CVT employing a moving-pulley-inspired wire-routing structure is introduced. The resultant force generated by the wire tensions acting on the pulley that passively increases the flexion moment arm and transmission ratio according to the applied load without additional actuators, sensors, or control. Experimental results demonstrate a maximum output-force amplification of 4.19-fold and a mean amplification of 3.6-fold across the tested flexion angles ranging from 15 degrees to 75 degrees through moment-arm adaptation, thereby substantially expanding the achievable force-speed operating range. Furthermore, dexterous ball-rolling experiments verify that passive transmission adaptation can be achieved while preserving abduction-adduction functionality. These results demonstrate a scalable transmission design strategy for compact multi-DoF robotic hands.

摘要（中文）：本文提出一种紧凑型二自由度（DoF）机器人手指，采用屈曲选择性无级变速器（CVT），以实现宽范围力-速度工作区间。受人类掌指关节（MCP）功能分化的启发，该机构通过选择性地将被动CVT分配给屈伸自由度，同时为内收-外展自由度保留直接传动，从而实现了特定自由度的传动差异化。为实现宽泛的力-速度工作区间，屈曲路径中嵌入了一种力响应式被动CVT，而内收-外展路径则保留直接传动。为在多自由度MCP机构中选择性实现传动自适应，引入了一种基于移动滑轮启发式导线布线结构的输出侧被动CVT。由作用在滑轮上的导线张力产生的合力，能够根据施加的负载被动增加屈曲力臂和传动比，无需额外执行器、传感器或控制。实验结果表明，通过力臂自适应，在15°至75°的测试屈曲角度范围内，最大输出力放大倍数为4.19倍，平均放大倍数为3.6倍，从而显著扩展了可达的力-速度工作区间。此外，灵巧滚球实验验证了在内收-外展功能保持的同时，可实现被动传动自适应。这些成果展示了一种适用于紧凑型多自由度机器人手部设计的可扩展传动策略。

Authors: JaeHyung Jang, Jee-Hwan Ryu

Context-Aware Intelligent Vehicles AutonomousDriving

context-aware intelligent vehicles multi-modal fusion temporal context modeling connected vehicles

简要说明：该综述主张将上下文作为智能车辆的一等原则，回顾了环境理解、规划控制、安全与连接的方法，并指出了构建统一上下文引擎的关键挑战。

TLDR: This survey argues for treating context as a first-class principle in intelligent vehicles, reviewing methods for environment understanding, planning, safety, and connectivity, and identifying key challenges for a unified contextual engine.

Abstract: Intelligent vehicles increasingly support adaptive applications beyond driving themselves, ranging from context-aware ADAS and automated driving to in-cabin monitoring and fleet management, all under tight requirements on accuracy, latency, cost, and reliability. Meeting these requirements is challenging because vehicles operate in complex, uncertain, and rapidly changing environments while running on resource-constrained computing platforms. This paper argues that context-situational factors that give meaning to sensor signals and constrain decisions-should be treated as a first-class principle for next-generation vehicle systems, and operationalized as a unified, shared state for learning, risk assessment, and closed-loop control across the software stack. We systematically review state-of-the- art (SOTA) context-aware methods spanning (i) environment understanding, (ii) planning and control, (iii) safety and security, and (iv) connected vehicles. Based on a trend analysis of context-aware design, we identify four key technical challenges in building a general contextual engine for future intelligent vehicles: multi-modal context fusion, temporal context modeling, handling rare events, and collaborative context sharing. We hope this survey will motivate the development of robust and efficient context-aware vehicle applications.

摘要（中文）：智能车辆正日益支持超越自动驾驶本身的适应性应用，涵盖从情境感知的高级驾驶辅助系统（ADAS）与自动驾驶，到舱内监控与车队管理，所有这些均需在精度、延迟、成本与可靠性方面满足严格的要求。满足这些要求颇具挑战性，因为车辆运行于复杂、不确定且快速变化的环境中，同时却部署在资源受限的计算平台上。本文主张，那些赋予传感器信号意义并约束决策的情境因素，应被视为下一代车辆系统的首要原则，并通过软件栈将其具体化为一个统一的、共享的状态，用于学习、风险评估与闭环控制。我们系统性地回顾了最先进的情境感知方法，涵盖以下四个方面：（i）环境理解，（ii）规划与控制，（iii）安全与安保，以及（iv）网联车辆。基于对情境感知设计趋势的分析，我们识别出构建未来智能车辆通用情境引擎所面临的四项关键技术挑战：多模态情境融合、时序情境建模、罕见事件处理，以及协作式情境共享。我们希望本综述能推动稳健且高效的情境感知车辆应用的发展。

Authors: Liangkai Liu, Shuyao Shi, Mingke Wang, Noah T. Curran, Chuan Li, Fan Bai, Kang G. Shin

AM-Bench: A Modular Simulation Suite and Benchmark for Aerial Manipulation Policy Learning Manipulation

aerial manipulation benchmark policy learning simulation suite multirotor

简要说明：AM-Bench 提出了一个用于空中操作策略学习的模块化模拟套件和基准测试，支持在多旋翼配置和12项任务中系统级评估本体、控制、干扰与策略的交互。

TLDR: AM-Bench introduces a modular simulation suite and benchmark for aerial manipulation policy learning, enabling system-level evaluation of how embodiment, control, disturbances, and policies interact across 12 tasks and multiple multirotor configurations.

Abstract: Standardized benchmarks have played a central role in advancing robot manipulation learning, yet most focus on ground-supported manipulation systems, which limits their applicability to dynamics-critical domains such as aerial manipulation (AM). AM presents distinct system-level challenges, including environmental disturbances, coupled dynamics between the manipulator and floating base, and constrained degrees of freedom. Consequently, task performance depends jointly on robot embodiment, low-level control, and high-level policy design. We introduce AM-Bench, a modular simulation suite and benchmark for multirotor-based AM policy learning. AM-Bench includes representative embodiments spanning underactuated, fully actuated, and overactuated systems, 12 tasks across contact, transport, and constrained interaction, configurable aerodynamic disturbances and actuator saturation, standard low-level controllers, and baseline policy-learning algorithms. Unlike prior manipulation benchmarks that primarily emphasize end-to-end policy performance, AM-Bench enables system-level evaluation of how embodiment, control, disturbances, and policy choices interact. We demonstrate its diagnostic value through three simulation studies spanning high-level policies, policy--control interfaces, and embodiments, together with real-world validation of modeled effects and a hardware test of the learning pipeline.

摘要（中文）：标准化基准测试在推动机器人操作学习方面发挥了核心作用，然而大多数基准测试聚焦于地面支撑的操作系统，这限制了其在动态关键领域（如空中操作）中的适用性。空中操作面临着独特的系统级挑战，包括环境扰动、操作器与浮动基座之间的耦合动力学，以及受约束的自由度。因此，任务性能同时依赖于机器人本体、底层控制与高层策略设计的协同作用。我们提出AM-Bench——一个面向多旋翼空中操作策略学习的模块化仿真套件与基准测试平台。AM-Bench包含代表性机器人平台，涵盖欠驱动、全驱动和过驱动系统，涉及接触、运输和约束交互等12项任务，可配置气动扰动与执行器饱和模块，提供标准底层控制器及基线策略学习算法。不同于以往主要强调端到端策略性能的操作基准测试，AM-Bench支持对机器人本体、控制、扰动与策略选择之间交互作用的系统级评估。我们通过三项仿真研究（涵盖高层策略、策略-控制接口及机器人本体）验证了其诊断价值，并结合真实世界中的建模效果验证与学习流程的硬件测试。

Authors: Yutong Wang, Dongjae Lee, Xiaofeng Guo, Yuanzhu Zhan, Yufei Jiang, Bavin Saravanan, Muqing Cao, Jia Xie, Chenyang Mao, Sebastian Scherer, Junyi Geng, Guanya Shi

A Wearable Pneumatic Device for Continuous, Closed-Loop, Bidirectional Tactile Interaction HumanoidEmbodied

wearable haptic device pneumatic actuator tactile sensing closed-loop control teleoperation

简要说明：本文提出一种可穿戴气动触觉设备，支持连续、闭环、双向的触觉交互，实验表明该设备能提升遥操作操纵性能并降低操作者工作负荷。

TLDR: This paper introduces a wearable pneumatic haptic device that enables continuous, closed-loop, bidirectional tactile interaction, demonstrating improved teleoperated manipulation performance and reduced workload.

Abstract: We present a system of two wearable pneumatic haptic devices that supports continuous, closed-loop, bidirectional tactile interaction at perceptually relevant force and temporal scales. A single device can contain up to twelve pressure sensing channels connected to textile-based pneumatic pouches. Each channel in a device can be used as a sensor, an actuator, or both. As an actuator with integrated sensing, the channel generates stable skin indentation through local closed-loop control. As a sensor, a channel can be mounted (or worn) on any surface, including on a robot gripper or on the human body, and used to measure touch interactions with the environment or a human user. A distributed architecture supports sustained pressure output, rapid dynamic response, and wireless pairing of identical devices in a system to transmit and reproduce tactile pressure signals in real time. Device-level characterization demonstrates force bandwidth exceeding 30 Hz, rapid and well-damped step responses, and extended pressure retention compared to prior compact pneumatic platforms. Human studies show that pressure-based fingertip feedback enables discrimination of force and stiffness, improves teleoperated manipulation by reducing applied pressures by up to 23.1% and task duration by up to 27.4%, and lowers subjective mental workload by 18.8%, particularly under visually constrained conditions. By unifying tactile sensing and haptic feedback within a single pneumatic modality, the device provides a practical foundation for bidirectional touch interaction in teleoperation.

摘要（中文）：我们提出了一种由两个可穿戴气动触觉装置组成的系统，能够在感知相关的力和时间尺度上支持连续、闭环的双向触觉交互。单个装置最多可容纳十二个压力传感通道，这些通道与基于织物的气动囊相连。装置中的每个通道既可作为传感器，也可作为执行器，或同时兼具两种功能。作为集成传感的执行器，该通道通过局部闭环控制产生稳定的皮肤压痕。作为传感器，该通道可安装（或佩戴）于任何表面，包括机器人夹爪或人体，用于测量与外界环境或人类用户的触觉交互。分布式架构支持持续的压力输出、快速动态响应，以及系统中相同装置间的无线配对，以实时传输和再现触觉压力信号。 装置级特性测试表明，与以往的紧凑型气动平台相比，其力带宽超过30赫兹，阶跃响应快速且阻尼良好，压力保持时间更长。人体实验结果显示，基于手指尖的压力反馈能够实现对力和刚度的区分，在遥操作中使施加压力降低高达23.1%，任务完成时间缩短高达27.4%，并将主观脑力负荷降低18.8%，尤其在视觉受限条件下效果显著。通过将触觉感知与力触觉反馈统一于单一气动模式，该装置为遥操作中的双向触觉交互提供了实用基础。

Authors: Cosima du Pasquier, Aliyah Smith, Serin Huber, Joshua Phelps, Ilana A. Cohen, Ava Chen, Monroe Kennedy, Allison M. Okamura

Potential-Guided Particle Steering for Negation-Constrained Dexterous Grasping Manipulation

dexterous grasping negation constraint Sequential Monte Carlo classifier-free guidance 3D part grounding

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于顺序蒙特卡洛和无分类器指导的推理阶段框架，无需负例训练数据即可在灵巧抓取中强制执行否定约束（例如“避免抓取瓶身”），并构建了基准数据集NegGrasp用于评估。

TLDR: This paper introduces an inference-time framework using Sequential Monte Carlo and classifier-free guidance to enforce negation constraints (e.g., 'avoid the body') in dexterous grasping without requiring negation-specific training data, and presents a benchmark NegGrasp for evaluation.

Abstract: Language-driven dexterous grasp models, such as DextER, perform well when instructions specify where to grasp, but we find they fail systematically when an instruction also specifies where not to grasp (e.g., "grasp the handle but avoid the body"). Existing training corpora, DexGYSNet among them, contain virtually no avoidance instructions, and collecting examples for every possible constraint is impractical. Moreover, because every part mentioned during training denotes a contact target, models may interpret a forbidden part as another region to grasp rather than one to avoid. We therefore introduce an inference-time framework for negation-constrained dexterous grasping that requires no negation-specific training examples. Combining Sequential Monte Carlo with classifier-free guidance, our method guides sampling toward the instructed part while pruning candidates headed for the forbidden region, without any negation examples during training. A frozen 3D part-grounding model localizes the forbidden region from the language instruction. To evaluate this setting, we construct NegGrasp, a benchmark of paired positive/negative instructions with constraint-aware metrics that credit a grasp only if it both accomplishes the task and respects the stated constraint. On NegGrasp, our method reduces the violation rate of the strongest baseline from 57.9% to 17.2% while improving both constraint-aware and physical success.

摘要（中文）：基于语言的灵巧抓取模型（如DextER）在指令明确指定抓取位置时表现良好，但我们发现当指令同时指定不可抓取位置时（例如"抓取手柄但避开主体"），这些模型会系统性失效。现有训练语料库（包括DexGYSNet）几乎不包含回避指令，且为每种可能的约束收集示例并不现实。此外，由于训练中提及的每个部位均被视为接触目标，模型可能将禁止部位误解为另一个待抓取区域而非需回避区域。为此，我们提出了一种无需专用否定训练示例的推理时框架，用于实现带否定约束的灵巧抓取。该方法结合序贯蒙特卡洛与无分类器引导，在训练阶段无需任何否定示例即可将采样导向指定部位，同时剪除朝向禁止区域的候选方案。通过冻结的3D部件定位模型，我们从语言指令中定位禁止区域。为评估该场景，我们构建了NegGrasp基准数据集，包含成对的正/否定指令及约束感知指标——仅当抓取动作既完成任务又满足规定约束时才判定为有效。在NegGrasp上，我们的方法将最强基线的违反率从57.9%降至17.2%，同时提升了约束感知成功率与物理成功率。

Authors: Geonho Kim, SooGon Kim, Jongmin Lee

Exploring Nonlinear Body Oscillations for Natural Quadruped Gaits Locomotion

quadruped gaits nonlinear normal modes embodied intelligence compliant robot black-box optimization

简要说明：本文提出了一种框架，通过利用非线性身体振荡设计四足机器人，使其产生自然步态，并在柔性机器人eBert上证明非线性正常模态可通过黑箱优化生成不同速度的独特步态。

TLDR: This paper presents a framework for designing quadruped robots that exploit nonlinear body oscillations to generate natural gaits, demonstrating on the compliant robot eBert that nonlinear normal modes can produce distinct gaits with different speeds via black-box optimization.

Abstract: Animals' body morphology shapes the gait patterns they can perform, where mechanical resonance reduces the need for active control. By tuning posture and muscle stiffness, they leverage their embodied intelligence to achieve effective gaits for different speeds. In contrast, most quadruped robots are not specifically designed to exploit mechanical resonance due to the complexity of nonlinear dynamics and require dedicated locomotion controllers. To provide an alternative, we present a proof of concept framework making the nonlinear dynamics of a robot predictable in the design process and show how this knowledge can be leveraged such that multi-gait locomotion can emerge from nonlinear resonances, shaped by gravity, inertia, and elasticity. We present the highly compliant quadruped robot eBert, on which we identify six nonlinear normal modes (NNMs) using our new theoretical tools and validate their existence in simulation and hardware. With black-box optimization to determine step length, simulations show how each NNM naturally develops into a distinct gait, manifesting different speeds, which also largely transfers to the robotic hardware. Our experiments show that eBert can exploit its mechanics to generate task-specific movements which may serve as foundation for designing a new generation of agile and efficient robots leveraging embodied intelligence.

摘要（中文）：动物的身体形态决定了其所能执行的步态模式，其中机械共振减少了对主动控制的需求。通过调整姿态和肌肉刚度，动物利用其具身智能实现不同速度下的有效步态。相比之下，大多数四足机器人由于非线性动力学的复杂性，并未专门设计利用机械共振，且需要专用的运动控制器。为提供替代方案，我们提出了一种概念验证框架，使机器人的非线性动力学在设计过程中变得可预测，并展示如何利用这一知识，使多步态运动能够从由重力、惯性和弹性塑造的非线性共振中涌现。我们介绍了一种高柔顺性四足机器人eBert，利用新理论工具在其上识别出六种非线性正则模态（NNMs），并通过仿真和硬件验证了其存在性。通过黑箱优化确定步长，仿真表明每种NNM自然演变为具有不同速度的独特步态，且这一特性在很大程度上迁移至机器人硬件。我们的实验表明，eBert能够利用其力学特性生成特定任务的动作，这有望为设计新一代利用具身智能的敏捷高效机器人奠定基础。

Authors: Annika Schmidt, Davide Calzolari, Florian Loeffl, Arne Sachtler, Daniel Seidel, Milan Herrmann, Robert Burger, Thomas Gumpert, Antonin Raffin, Tristan Ehlert, Maximilian Pries, David Wandinger, Florian Schmidt, Manuel Keppler, Jinoh Lee, Alin Albu-Schäffer

Scene Graph-based Driving Scenario Extraction for Automotive Egocentric Datasets AutonomousDriving

scene graphs Linear Temporal Logic scenario extraction automated driving egocentric datasets

简要说明：一种利用场景图和线性时序逻辑(LTL)从自车视角汽车数据集中自动提取驾驶场景的方法，在Argoverse 2和行车记录仪视频上进行了评估。

TLDR: A method using scene graphs and Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) to automatically extract driving scenarios from egocentric automotive datasets, evaluated on Argoverse 2 and dashcam footage.

Abstract: Extracting scenarios from unlabelled real-world sensor data streams is a critical but challenging task in the development process of automated driving systems (ADS). Automatically sifting through large datasets to spatially and temporally locate critical scenarios can enable scenario-based coverage analysis of ADS datasets. In this paper, we present a method for extracting scenarios from egocentric datasets using scene graphs and Linear Temporal Logic (LTL). We first process egocentric sensor data and HD maps to generate a sequence of scene graphs representing a driving scenario. Next, we use LTL to formally specify driving scenarios of interest, then extract all instances of the scenarios from the dataset using an off-the-shelf model checker, which evaluates the LTL formula against the sequence of scene graphs. Our approach can be used on both simulated and real world datasets. We evaluate the method on the training and validation datasets from Argoverse 2 consisting of 850 15-second real-world driving logs, and several videos of dashcam footage. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach for extracting and querying scenarios by evaluating against a rule-based benchmark based on track annotations and HD maps.

摘要（中文）：从无标签真实世界传感器数据流中提取场景是自动驾驶系统（ADS）开发过程中一项关键但具有挑战性的任务。自动筛选大规模数据集以在空间和时间上定位关键场景，可实现对ADS数据集进行基于场景的覆盖分析。本文提出一种利用场景图与线性时序逻辑（LTL）从自我中心数据集中提取场景的方法。我们首先处理自我中心传感器数据和高精度地图，生成表示驾驶场景的场景图序列；随后采用LTL对感兴趣的驾驶场景进行形式化规约，并通过现成的模型检验器对场景图序列进行LTL公式评估，从而从数据集中提取所有符合该场景的实例。该方法可同时应用于仿真与真实世界数据集。我们基于Argoverse 2的训练与验证数据集（包含850条15秒真实驾驶记录及多段行车记录仪视频）进行方法评估，并通过与基于轨迹标注和高精度地图的规则基准进行对比，验证了本方法在场景提取与查询中的有效性。

Authors: Stefan Ramdhan, Kyanna Dagenais, Vera Pantelic, Victor Bandur, Mark Lawford

Beyond Textual Chain-of-Thought: A Survey on Action-Grounded Reasoning in Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

action-grounded reasoning chain-of-thought autonomous driving intermediate representations survey

简要说明：本综述系统性地回顾了171篇关于自动驾驶中基于行动推理的论文，提出了一种分类法，将方法分为基于语言、视觉空间、潜在动态和外部化推理四类，并指出开放前沿在于能与现实世界结合、实时行动且可在安全关键系统中验证的中间表示。

TLDR: This survey systematically reviews 171 papers on action-grounded reasoning for autonomous driving, proposing a taxonomy that categorizes methods into language-based, visual-spatial, latent-dynamic, and externalized reasoning, and identifies the open frontier as grounded intermediate representations coupled to real-time action under safety-critical constraints.

Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning powers generative models by eliciting intermediate steps before producing an answer. In autonomous driving, the answer is a continuous action. Thus its reasoning must share the same spatiotemporal structure as the physical world. This survey studies the resulting shift from textual CoT to action-grounded reasoning. Surveying 171 papers, including 130 method papers and 41 benchmarks, datasets, surveys, and analysis papers, we propose a representation-centered taxonomy that treats the form of the intermediate state as the organizing axis. We systematize the 130 methods into four categories: language-based, visual-spatial, latent-dynamic, and externalized reasoning, further divided into 13 subtypes tied to distinct regions of interests. Our synthesis shows that the open frontier of reasoning in driving agents lies in intermediate representations that can be grounded in the real world, coupled to real-time action, and verified under safety-critical systems. Project page: https://github.com/tangzhengxu/awesome-av-cot.

摘要（中文）：思维链（Chain-of-thought, CoT）推理通过引导生成模型在产生最终答案前输出中间步骤来增强其能力。在自动驾驶领域，最终答案表现为连续动作。因此，其推理过程必须与物理世界保持相同的时空结构。本综述研究了从文本型CoT向基于行动（action-grounded）推理的范式转变。我们调研了171篇论文（包括130篇方法论文及41篇基准、数据集、综述与分析论文），提出了一种以表征为中心的分类法，将中间状态的形式作为组织主轴。我们将130种方法系统化为四大类别：基于语言推理、视觉空间推理、潜在动态推理与外部化推理，并进一步细分为与不同关注区域相关联的13种子类型。综合研究表明：驾驶智能体推理的前沿开放领域在于构建能够扎根现实世界、耦合实时行动并在安全关键系统下可验证的中间表征。项目主页：https://github.com/tangzhengxu/awesome-av-cot
